title: Woman Waving in Garden, 1940s B&W Backyard Snapshot, US
description: A 1940 vintage black-and-white snapshot depicting a woman seated in a shaded backyard garden area, warmly waving towards the photographer. A flower bed with distinct large-leafed plants sits in the midground, with a wooden house or garden shed tucked behind dense foliage on the left. The scene captures everyday domestic life in suburban America at the turn of the 1940s decade.
